The '''Namadii system''' was a [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]] [[Star system/Legends|star system]]. It was a part of the [[Churnis sector/Legends|Churnis sector]] and lay at the endpoint of the [[Namadii Corridor/Legends|Namadii Corridor]] [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperlane]]. The system also contained the astronomical object [[Namadii/Legends|Namadii]].

At various points in [[Time/Legends|time]], the Namadii system fell within the borders of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]], the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], and the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]]. The [[New Republic Defense Force/Legends|military forces]] of the latter passed through the system on their way to the [[Adumar system]] in [[13 ABY/Legends|13 ABY]].

==Description==
The Namadii [[Star system/Legends|system]] was located in the [[Churnis sector/Legends|Churnis sector]],<ref name="EAOC" /> a part of the [[New Territories/Legends|New Territories]] portion of<ref name="TEA" /> the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]].<ref name="EAOC" /> It was situated at the endpoint of the [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperlane]] known as the [[Namadii Corridor/Legends|Namadii Corridor]], which linked it to the [[Ansion system/Legends|Ansion system]].<ref name="TEA" /> During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], the [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]] route stretched past the Namadii system, linking it to<ref name="AoI">''[[The Clone Wars: Act on Instinct]]''</ref> the [[Adumar system/Legends|Katorrs system]] in [[Wild Space/Legends|Wild Space]].<ref name="TEA" /> The Namadii system contained the astronomical object of the [[Namadii/Legends|same name]].<ref name="AoRCR">[[Star Wars: Age of Rebellion Core Rulebook|''Star Wars: Age of Rebellion'' Core Rulebook]]</ref>

==History==
The Namadii system lay in an area of [[Realspace/Legends|space]] [[Scout/Legends|explored]] between [[3000 BBY]] and [[1000 BBY/Legends|1000 BBY]]. During the Clone Wars of [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]] to [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]], the system was located in the territory held by the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]],<ref name="TEA" /> and in the first campaigns of that conflict, the [[Seventh Army|Seventh Sector Army]] of the Republic was tasked with fighting the [[Confederacy military/Legends|military forces]] of the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] in the system's vicinity.<ref name="EGTW" /> Shortly after the acquisition of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Ukio/Legends|Ukio]] by the [[Commerce Guild/Legends|Commerce Guild]] during that conflict, the Namadii system was featured on a [[The galaxy/Legends|galactic]] [[Map/Legends|map]] displayed on a [[Viewscreen/Legends|viewscreen]] at a facility run by [[Passel Argente/Legends|Passel Argente]], the [[Magistrate/Legends|Magistrate]]<ref name="AoI" /> of the [[Corporate Alliance/Legends|Corporate Alliance]].<ref name="DB Argente">{{DB|character|passelargente|Argente, Passel}}</ref>

The Namadii system was situated in territory under the control of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] by [[17 BBY/Legends|17 BBY]]. By [[12 ABY/Legends|12 ABY]], it fell within the borders of the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]]. A [[13 ABY/Legends|year later]], [[New Republic Defense Force/Legends|military forces]] of the New Republic traveled through the Namadii system as they advanced along the Namadii Corridor toward a [[Battle of Adumar|confrontation]] with the [[Imperial Remnant/Legends|Imperial Remnant]] in the Katorrs system.<ref name="EGTW" /> Around [[25 ABY/Legends|25 ABY]], the population of the Namadii system numbered from 1 million to 10 million.<ref name="TEA" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Namadii system was introduced in the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', authored by [[Daniel Wallace]] and [[Jason Fry]], which placed it in grid square I-6.<ref name="TEA" /> ''[[The Clone Wars: Act on Instinct]]'', a [[Star Wars comic books|webcomic]] authored by [[Pablo Hidalgo]] and released on [[StarWars.com]]<ref name="AoI" /> over the span of the 2009<ref name="AoI announcement">{{SWArchive|url=theclonewars/news20091001comics/index.html|text=New ''Clone Wars'' Web Comic Tells Original Tale}}</ref>&ndash;[[2010]]<ref name="Lethal Trackdown Ep Guide">{{SWArchive|url=theclonewars/guide/episode222.html|text=''The Clone Wars'' Episode Guide: Lethal Trackdown}}</ref> [[The Clone Wars: Season Two|second season]] of the ''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars]]'' television series,<ref name="AoI announcement" /> featured the first appearance of the system.<ref name="AoI" />
